name: Impact Collision Switch
description: Like a robot bumper! Mechanical microswitch that triggers immediately upon physical collision.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a robot bumper! Mechanical microswitch that triggers immediately upon physical collision.
wiringGuidance: Connect one terminal to GND (Dark Slate wire) and the NO terminal to digital pin 3 (Green wire). Use Arduino internal pull-up resistor.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to enable INPUT_PULLUP in code, resulting in erratic floating values.
Connecting to NC (Normally Closed) instead of NO (Normally Open), reversing switch logic.

miniExperiment.title: Bumper Impact Trigger
miniExperiment.circuit: Connect Common to GND, NO to Digital Pin 3.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor prints 'CRASH! Bumper triggered!' whenever the microswitch lever is pressed.
